data.title: 英梨梨 · 夕阳画室里咬铅笔的回眸
data.description: 放学后的美术活动室内，晚霞如火般穿透落地窗洒满画架。英梨梨嘴里轻轻咬着2B绘图铅笔的末端，金色的双马尾在夕照下泛着璀璨的金辉。当听到脚步声回过头来，看到少年的瞬间，少女标志性的小虎牙若隐若现，整张脸腾地红透，结结巴巴地呵斥对方不许偷看画布。
data.action: biting pencil tip, turning around from easel, heavy tsundere blush
data.lighting: blazing golden hour sunset flooding through tall windows
data.promptProse: Turning abruptly from her canvas in the sunset-flooded school art room, Eriri Spencer Sawamura bites the tip of her drawing pencil. Her twin blonde tails gleam golden against the light as her blue eyes flash with a furious, deeply flustered tsundere blush.
data.animaCaption: Eriri biting her pencil turning around with a furious tsundere blush.
